confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Bariloche prices. The price search returned crowdsourced cost-of-living figures that disagree with each other and may be stale. Of the ten anchors, I took beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal for two from those figures. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local relationship to beer. All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, and I did not inspect any booking pages. Argentine peso volatility and the July ski-season peak add further uncertainty. The RBA figure is the 18 Nov 2026 4pm rate shown on the RBA overview page. A 19 Nov figure of 0.6677 appeared on a statistics table, but its metadata looked stale, so I did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared against Argentine Andean and Patagonian tourist towns such as Mendoza and El Calafate. Bariloche is about 20% pricier than Argentina overall, and July is peak ski season.
